messages:
elaine: Quick follow-up from PM for INCIDENT-2026 (high mem on gen-serve). I sketched remediations and owners below — can folks confirm owners, Jira IDs, and RACI by EOD? TL;DR: need fixes + retrospective action for recurring pattern. Actions:
- A1: Add per-model mem limits + alert (owner: jordan)
- A2: Move hotspot models to dedicated pool (owner: sam)
- A3: Postmortem-runbook update & playbook (owner: maria)
- A4: CI test for kv cache eviction (owner: leo)
Please reply with Jira ticket numbers and R/A/C/I mapping. I'll compile.

jordan: I can take A1. I'll create INF-2357 for the alert + INF-2358 for the mem-limits change. R=jordan A=elaine C=oncall SRE I=pm

sam: Taking A2. Need help from infra to size a small dedicated pool. Will spin INF-2360. A=sam R=infra-team C=platform I=pm

maria: A3 ack. Will draft playbook + checklist. INF-2361. R=maria A=product C=eng_sre I=pm

leo: A4 yes. I'll add a unit/integration test and CI job. INF-2362. R=leo A=eng-ml C=qa I=pm

ton (infra): Quick note — infra capacity request for INF-2360 will need org approval. Sam, loop in partnerships for cloud credits? :money_with_wings:

sam: noted, looping @partners. Also marking INF-2360 as blocker for cutover timeline.

ana (oncall-bot): Incident bridge summary posted: https://redwood/reports/INC-2026

tim: small ask — can we add a recurring incident review item to the ops-rotation? This pattern (mem spikes with long-context models) popped twice in last 3 months.

elaine: Good call. I'll add a monthly recurring ticket INF-2370 to track pattern and prevention. R=pm A=eng-ops C=research I=execs

jordan: Quick Q — for per-model mem limits, are we doing soft throttle or hard OOM guard? leaning soft + alert.

leo: soft + degrade seems safer. we can set cpu/mem reservations and a soft threshold hook that returns 429 with retry-after.

maria: I'll include the user-facing fallback language in the playbook too.

sam: I'll PR an initial runbook draft to the postmortem repo. tagging this thread for follow-up sync on friday.

elaine: thanks all. I'll compile this into the postmortem doc and update the action owners table. If you don't put a ticket by EOD I'll file on your behalf and assign. :white_check_mark:
